audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases[0-6].side are all 'Skill' (Maokai) while content win[0-6] all say 'Brand', and the content prose (early/mid/late) independently describes Brand winning every stage from poke range and burn. The two layers contradict each other on every row of the level chart.
audit.why: Brand out-ranges Maokai with Pillar of Flame (900) and Sear (1050) before Twisted Advance (W) is up at 2, his W-Q-E rotation chunks through Maokai's durability at 3, Blaze stacks shred tank HP through 4-5, Pyroclasm punishes grouped engages at 6, and the percent-health burn scales into every later fight. The packet levelChart and the content prose already agree Brand wins all 7 stages; only the full layer disagreed.
audit.corrected: Flip phases[0-6].side to Brand with why text grounded in the specific ability interaction per stage (see edits).

audit.why: Power spikes are already covered by spikes[0-3] (Lvl 2 poke, Lvl 6 Pyroclasm grouping, 1st item full combo, late percent-health burn) and match the kit's real cooldowns and ranges.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns names Brand's Sear stun condition but carries no cooldown numbers at all (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT), and dosFull[1].d / dontsFull[2].d are verbatim copies of tradeGood/tradeBad pasted under unrelated titles (lint COPY_PASTE_BLEED) instead of stating the ability interaction their own title promises.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns now carries Sear 8/7.5/7/6.5/6s, Pillar of Flame 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s, and Pyroclasm 100/90/80s. dosFull[1].d now describes zoning his Pillar of Flame spot with Sapling Toss (E). dontsFull[2].d now explains why Bramble Smash shouldn't be spent on poke.

edits.before: Sapling the brush — the lane's hedges are yours now; trades start with a tree's consent.
edits.after: Brand out-ranges you cold: Pillar of Flame (900) and Sear (1050) poke before Twisted Advance (W) exists to close the gap.

edits.before: W threat begins: the point-click root governs their carry's spacing.
edits.after: Sear only stuns the ablaze, but his Pillar of Flame lights that stack first — any step-up before your W is live eats the chain.

edits.before: Full kit: E-zone the trades, W the commits, Q the disengage — the swamp votes.
edits.after: His full W-Q-E rotation chunks you and your ADC through your durability faster than your passive heals it back.

edits.before: Sustain the margins with passive heals and sapling chip — attrition is a tree's game.
edits.after: Blaze stacks burn through sustained trades faster than expected, shredding tank HP that your Sapling Toss zone can't out-damage.

edits.before: Nature's Grasp online — the root wave starts fights from fog and ends dives in it.
edits.after: Pyroclasm's bounce AoE punishes any grouped step; Nature's Grasp can't safely close the gap while his R is up.

edits.before: First item: the roots chain and the saplings tax every brush.
edits.after: His first AP item completes the W-Q-E combo into a near-delete on your ADC and a heavy chunk on you.

edits.before: Late Maokai is the engage forest: R the formation, W the carry, and Q whatever the roots deliver.
edits.after: Percent-health burn and AoE scale into every fight; you flank from fog with MR items rather than walk your team into his range.

edits.before: - Brand Sear (Stun): matchup-defining — Q only stuns the ablaze — after eating W or E, the stun line is the dodge. Read it before every duo step-up. - Your Q Bramble Smash answers exactly one disaster per cooldown. - Spend the R on swing moments only.
edits.after: - Brand's Sear (Q) stuns only the ablaze, 8-6s cooldown — after eating W (10-8s) or E, the stun line is the dodge. Read it before every duo step-up. - Your Q Bramble Smash (7-5s) answers one disaster per cooldown. - Save the 100/90/80s R for swing moments only.

edits.before: Bait the answer, start the chain, and let your carry collect — engage trades are all-or-nothing; pick the all.
edits.after: Sapling Toss (E) in his favored Pillar of Flame spot denies the angle — he pays for casting there again.

edits.before: Engaging into a banked disengage — the chain that starts answered is a donation with armor.
edits.after: Bramble Smash is your one combo answer — burn it on chip poke and you're empty when he commits.

notes: Full-layer level chart (phases[].side/why/rating) was fully templated and disagreed with content win[]/whys on every row; corrected to agree with content, which was already grounded in real ability names/ranges/cooldowns and matched the packet levelChart.
